blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Open sort menu traps Tab and ignores Escape) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Keyboard users (WCAG 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap, 2.1.1 Keyboard): once the menu is open, pressing Tab or Shift+Tab is cancelled and cycles focus among the four items, and Escape does nothing, so the user cannot move on to the product list or dismiss the menu without picking a sort order. Stop handling Tab (let it close the menu and move focus on, as the WAI-ARIA APG menu button pattern does), and add an Escape handler that calls setOpen(false) and returns focus to the "Sort" button. Shift+Tab is also caught by the same branch and moves forward instead of backward. A native <select> would give all of this for free.
findings.title: Open sort menu traps Tab and ignores Escape

findings.evidence: <button ref={button} type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>
findings.recommendation: Screen reader users (WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value): aria-expanded is hard-coded to "false", so after pressing Enter on "Sort: Newest" the button is still announced as collapsed while the menu is open. Bind it to the state: aria-expanded={open}.
findings.title: Menu button always announces "collapsed"
